purpose: Independently confirm or falsify the already-preregistered normalized-entropy and meeting-day candidate signals from the first regime-validation universe, using new meeting IDs and unchanged frozen B1a semantics, bins, thresholds, and retention rules.

confirmatory_hypotheses.rule: Using the unchanged bins [0,0.70), [0.70,0.85), [0.85,1.0000001], the low-entropy bin must have higher Top1 accuracy than the high-entropy bin to count as directional replication. If the low-entropy scored cell has n<10 the test is INCONCLUSIVE_INSUFFICIENT_CELL rather than promoted or re-binned.
confirmatory_hypotheses.operationalization: No purchase rule or model change may be adopted from this confirmation alone even if the direction replicates.

confirmatory_hypotheses.rule: Using exact meeting day indices with no merging, day 2 must have higher Top1 accuracy than both day 1 and day 3 to count as directional replication. Missing day cells remain missing and are not repaired after outcomes.
confirmatory_hypotheses.operationalization: No day-index filter may be adopted from this confirmation alone.

confirmatory_hypotheses.rule: Report the unchanged top1-margin bins [0,0.05), [0.05,0.15), [0.15,1.0]. No monotonicity is assumed. This dimension is retained as a falsification/control slice and must not be re-binned after outcomes.

selection_rule: The six meeting IDs above are frozen before target result scoring for this confirmation.
For each fixed meeting, enumerate day indices 01,02,03,04 and race numbers 01..12 in listed-meeting/day/race order.
During selection, use only the existing fail-closed PRE parser required by frozen B1a. A candidate enters iff all mandatory PRE fields parse successfully.
Retain every PRE-complete candidate. Do not stop at a favorable count, replace after outcomes, or delete unfavorable races.

Fail closed before dedicated target-result scoring if any fixed meeting collides with seed/temporal batches, independent-meeting batch3, coverage-balanced batch4, the first regime-validation batch5, or explicitly known smaller scored historical meetings.
DEV2000 remains exposed diagnostic evidence only. These meetings are temporally outside its 2026-03-01 through 2026-04-10 window and must not be represented as DEV2000 reuse.

Require at least 120 successfully frozen races across at least five of the six fixed meetings; otherwise fail closed before dedicated result scoring and do not alter the selection rule after seeing outcomes.
Freeze all PRE inputs, frozen-B1a probabilities/rankings, exact regime variables, unchanged entropy bins, unchanged margin bins, and meeting-day indices before dedicated result-page scoring.
After prediction lock, attempt result scoring for every frozen race. Result-fetch/parser failures remain explicit and are never silently substituted.
No odds or payout data are required or used for this probability/ranking confirmation.
